_comment: Citation for the 10e core EPIC HERO 1-per-army rule. Faction-neutral, universal across every codex.

simulator.epic_hero_one_per_army.quoted_text: EPIC HERO units can only be taken once per army.
simulator.epic_hero_one_per_army.trigger: army composition / list-building; a UnitProfile carrying the EPIC HERO unit keyword has already been drafted into the army
simulator.epic_hero_one_per_army.effect: duplicate inclusion of the same EPIC HERO datasheet is refused. Enforced by code.army_builder.is_epic_hero gates in build_random_army, build_faction_random_army, and code.archetypes._random_fill — each tracks the set of EPIC HERO profile names already added and filters candidates that match. Faction-neutral.
